offering_description.value: Owns and operates ethylene production assets on the US Gulf Coast and sells ethylene and co-products, mainly to its parent under long-term contracts, with some third-party sales. It makes ethylene from purchased ethane and propane feedstock and delivers it by pipeline to nearby customers.

customer_segment.value: B2B: parent petrochemical company and third-party chemical producers

revenue_model.value: product sales: ethylene and co-products sold under long-term supply contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts purchased ethane and propane into ethylene, sold to affiliate and third-party chemical buyers; asset operator: owns and runs ethylene plants and pipelines under long-term contracts

geography_served.value: US regional: Louisiana and Kentucky, with delivery by pipeline to nearby chemical plants

specialization.value: niche specialist: ethylene and its co-products from a small number of plants

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: long-term supply contracts with parent and third-party buyers; other: pipeline delivery to customer sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental air and water permits and process safety rules from EPA and OSHA

notes: Facility ownership shares and product mix may have changed since my information was last current; verify before use.
